id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

name.description:
Unique name of the Python module.

This name is used both as a folder name in the local and remote file systems,
and as the package name during import (e.g., `from name import ...`).

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

modulePath.description:
Remote C3 FileSystem path where this module is stored.

This path may point to either a `remote://` or `meta://` location, where depending on
how the module was created. It serves as the base for locating all files
belonging to the module.

title:
A persistable Python module stored in the C3 platform.

This type provides methods to:
- Upload and download module code with path-aware zipping and unzipping logic
- Import symbols from Python packages/modules dynamically

Modules are stored under namespaced paths in both local and remote environments based on the format:
`<type>/<id>/<name>/`, ensuring uniqueness and safe multi-user isolation.
name: Genai.PythonModule
